messages:
anya: Heads-up — Customer Omega needs a BYOK import tomorrow morning. Requirements: dual-operator import (two-person control), immutable audit retention for 7 years, and strict crypto-only access for app service accounts (no console/operator crypto ops). Need quick sync on RBAC, audit schema, escrow options, and incident handles. @sam @mike @jean @ops-oncall

sam: Quick question: are they supplying an HSM export blob for direct import or expecting us to accept an envelope-wrapped key via our KMS proxy?

anya: They specified vendor HSM import (they'll provide attestation artifacts). Also asked that operator accounts never get decrypt rights after import.

mike: For HSM import flow we need split operator workflow (operator1/operator2), import session transcript, attestation bound to CMK metadata. System should mark origin=EXTERNAL_HSM and restrict key usage to Encrypt/Decrypt only for designated service principals.

jean: RBAC suggestion: add entitlements `hsm.import.execute` (granted via JIT & MFA, ephemeral) and `cmk.metadata.viewer` (readonly). No long-lived operator decrypt role. App services get `cmk.crypto.client` only. Also require approval workflow where legal signs off for escrow involvement.

ops-oncall: Operational constraint: oncall does NOT perform import steps. If import fails mid-flight or the import host misbehaves, oncall runs the import-failure checklist: isolate host, revoke running tokens, and escalate to security. We'll need a clear failover path for traffic if we pause the imported key.

security-bot: alert: sidecar-hsm v2.3.1 flagged CVE-2025-0142 (tempfile leakage). Inventory: ~90 nodes in staging, 40 in canary prod using 2.3.1. https://internal.redwood/cves/CVE-2025-0142

mike: Can't accept new imports while that CVE is unmitigated. Mitigation options: (1) upgrade sidecar to patched 2.3.3 on import nodes, or (2) perform import in an isolated ephemeral pod with in-memory filesystem only. Prefer hardened import cluster with minimal attack surface.

sam: Audit retention: contract requires WORM-style immutability 7 years and provable chain-of-custody. Proposed minimal audit fields: operator OIDs, session id, attestation blob hash, HSM serial, import action checksum, immutable store URI, and a signed event envelope.

jean: Draft audit event example:
```
{"event":"hsm_import","session":"import-2025-omega-01","operators":["op-alice","op-bob"],"attestation_sha256":"<hex>","hsm_serial":"HSM-OMEGA-42","key_ref":"cmk:acct-omega:key-0001","worm_uri":"s3://redwood-worm/omega/imports/2025/03/01/"}
```

mike: Note: storing raw attestation blobs in plain storage may cross vendor privacy rules. Store blob hash in WORM and raw attestation encrypted in a restricted keystore (access audited, legal-approved).

anya: Incident response: if sidecar compromise suspected during/after import, customer will demand rotation and proof. Need timeline and comms template to meet SOC2 + customer SLA.

ops-oncall: Incident playbook (high level): 1) Quarantine import cluster network, 2) Revoke `cmk.crypto.client` tokens, 3) Run import integrity checks (`import-verify --session <id>`), 4) If integrity fails coordinate forced rotation/re-import with customer and vendor attestation. Include legal + compliance in notifications.

sam: Escrow options for customers who can't transfer keys permanently: (A) physical hardware escrow to approved vault w/ tamper-evident chain of custody, (B) split-wrapping where customer holds half of wrap key and Redwood holds the other half, requiring both to unwrap. Each has contract/DR implications.

jean: Split-wrap is attractive operationally but will need contractual thresholds (who can trigger unwrap, how to handle loss of one half). Also we must update backups, DR runbooks, and test rewrap/unwrap annually.

security-bot: ticket created SEC-1526 "Gate BYOK imports until sidecar vuln is mitigated" assigned to @mike

mike: I'll own SEC-1526. Immediate actions: (1) gate new imports, (2) stand up hardened ephemeral import cluster spec, (3) update runbooks and audit schema, (4) produce attestation handling SOP. Will deliver mitigation plan by EOD tomorrow.

jean: I'll produce the RBAC/JIT entitlement draft and ping legal for escrow/retention contract language. Posting update to the RBAC doc shortly.

ops-oncall: I'll prepare the customer-facing incident template + internal timeline checklist and add it to the runbook repo.

sam: Suggest adding a post-import automated verifier that runs `verify-hsm-attestation --session <id>` and emits a signed WORM event. Also add a gating check that rejects imports if sidecar version < 2.3.3.

mike: Agreed. Add pipeline step and gating.

anya: Next steps recap: block onboarding until SEC-1526 actions approved; jean -> RBAC/JIT draft; mike -> hardened import cluster spec + SOP; ops-oncall -> incident + customer template; sam -> verifier job & gating rule. Sync tomorrow 10:00. :thumbsup:

security-bot: SEC-1526 status: in_progress, owner: mike

jean: Uploaded initial RBAC draft: https://internal.redwood/docs/rbac/byok-import-jit-draft (comments welcome)

mike: Uploaded cluster spec to ticket SEC-1526

anya: Thanks all — closing thread for now, will reopen if new issues come up.
